description: Default finish for the rough-cut skill. Replays cutlist.json against the raw footage as a Premiere/CapCut timeline where every cut is an individually trimmable edit point on the original media — never a flattened render. Use immediately after building a cut list, whenever the job is not headed straight for a full HyperFrames graphics build. Time-to-timeline is the metric: this produces output in seconds.
